exposure: causes of respiratory distress (RDS, TTN, congenital pneumonia, PNA)
respiratory modality used (non-invasive vs. invasive respiratory support)
outcome: short term morbidities (nasal trauma, sepsis, septic shock, disseminated intravascular coagulation, necrotising enterocolitis, intraventricular haemorrhage)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 100 preterm newborns admitted to the neonatology department.
finding: Respiratory distress syndrome was the commonest cause of respiratory distress among admitted preterm newborns, and those requiring invasive respiratory support had significantly higher rates of short-term morbidities, retinopathy of prematurity, and mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the mode of delivery for 80% of the enrolled neonates.
birth_weight: Mean 1635.45 +/- 570.55 g, with 42% being very low birth weight.
gest_age: Mean 32.38 +/- 2.48 weeks, with 62% between 28 and <34 weeks.
